children: Weir PLC (LSE:WEIR) reported third-quarter orders up 8%, led by 10% aftermarket growth, and maintained full-year guidance despite operational and market headwinds. It warned the SAP S/4HANA rollout may weigh on margins in 2027–28, while saying it could deliver operating margins above 20% over the longer term.
: Weir PLC (WEIR) third-quarter orders rose 8%, led by aftermarket growth of 10%. Year-to-date book-to-bill was 1.10. The miner maintained full-year guidance despite operational and market headwinds.
: Weir PLC (WEIR) warned SAP S/4HANA rollout may weigh on margins in 2027–28, but said it could deliver operating margins above 20% over the longer term.
: Weir PLC (WEIR) said net debt is expected to finish 2026 slightly above its normal operating range of 0.5–1.5 times EBITDA, with the company expecting to return within that range during 2027.
: Weir PLC (WEIR) reported £80 million in cumulative savings from its Performance Excellence programme and remains on track to reach £90 million in 2026.
: Weir PLC (WEIR) said Capital Group notified it of a change in voting rights, crossing a disclosure threshold on 4 November. Shares are held in client accounts managed by Capital Group companies.
